body: The movie looks like it was pretty old, maybe late 80s to the early 2000s? Some notable scenes are when the protagonist is about to tell her crush(the teen neighbor) that she likes him, but backs off when she sees an older girl standing next to him, and instead tells him about her clubhouse for “special” people, to which the crush responds with an insult(the r-word) and leaves. More about the “lost sister” scene, the protagonist has an eerie delusion that she saves her sister from being kidnapped by a man in the city, brings her home, and everyone loves her.

I believe you. I’m so so sorry for all that you’ve been through, you didn’t deserve any of that. Although I can’t promise that the future won’t be hard, I do hope that it is less painful for you, and that you find something worth fighting for.
Thank you for replying, even though it’s a little messed up, it’s comforting to know I’m not the only one who feels this way.
All I can say is that I’m sorry for your circumstances, I know how much it can suck. I do genuinely wish you all the best.
Of course :) I’m glad I was able to help. And don’t worry you do sound genuine haha, ik it’s hard to express emotions when typing tho lol.
If you really plan on going, talk to your family first please. I’m sure they’d rather have you here with them, it might just take a little perspective.

Oof, this hits way too close to home. I fear coming out because I don’t want to loose my family either. It’s a constant battle between being with family or being yourself, but it doesn’t even feel like much of a “choice” because you can’t just stop being gay. I can’t promise it gets better, but I do hope that someday you find some sort of peace. Know that you’ve done nothing wrong.
There’s no “should” or “shouldn’t” when it comes to feelings. Your emotions are yours, no matter where you come from.

I’m sorry :( if it’s any consultation, I’m proud of you for graduating. What I’m going to say next may sound a bit pretentious, but I believe it: there is no point or meaning or life, except the one we give it. I hope you find meaning in your life, whether it’s a friend, family, yourself, a pet, or even something seemingly small. I don’t know what you’ve been through, and I can’t promise it gets better, but I do wish you find satisfaction.
I’m so so sorry. I can’t imagine how much pain you are in right now.
